name: rabisco
description: Stop (adedonha) online, multiplayer em tempo real, com cara de caderno da escola.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @rabisco/server" "npm run dev -w @rabisco/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rabisco/server && npm run build -w @rabisco/web
